subject: general
question: The parliamentary standing committees have a tenure of ________ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**one **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Parliamentary Standing Committees** in India have a tenure of **one year**
 
• **Parliamentary Standing Committees** in India are permanent committees that work throughout the year
 
 
• to scrutinize and oversee various aspects of legislation, government policies, and administration.
 
 
 
• They play a crucial role in enhancing the efficiency of parliamentary work by focusing on specific areas in detail. 
 
• These committees are divided based on different ministries and departments, such as Finance, Defense, Health, etc.
 
• There are currently **24 DRSCs**, with members drawn from both the Lok Sabha (lower house) and the Rajya Sabha (upper house).
